_comment: Blocky Minecraft-style fingers shown during casts (hand signs). Read by the mod (FingerFeature) and by Blender
(blender/lib/mcchar.py) so previews match the game exactly.
Geometry is for the RIGHT hand in the arm's model space (pixels), relative to the centre of the arm's bottom
face (the hand end): +y runs further down the arm, +x points to the palm (toward the body when the arm hangs),
-z points forward. The left hand mirrors x. Arm width is scaled for slim (3 px) skins.
Each finger: base [x, y, z], cross-section [sx, sz], two segment lengths, rest direction [pitch, roll] in degrees
(pitch tips the finger forward toward -z, roll toward the palm).
Shapes: per finger [curl1, curl2, splay] in degrees. curl bends toward the palm (90 = folded flat under the
hand), splay leans it forward (+) or back (-) across the other fingers. The thumb adds a 4th value: opposition.
